info.name: OS Management Hub Managed Instance Group API
managedInstanceGroup
Gets a list of all managed instance groups in a compartment.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group. This filter returns resources associated with this group.

params.name: softwareSourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the software source. This filter returns resources associated with this software source.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return resources that match the given display names.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.

params.name: archType
params.description: A filter to return only profiles that match the given archType.

params.name: osFamily
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given operating system family.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only managed instance groups that are in the specified state.

params.name: location
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.

params.name: locationNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.

params.name: isManagedByAutonomousLinux
params.description: Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

items.docs: Lists managed instance groups that match the specified compartment or managed instance group [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm). Filter the list against a variety of criteria including but not limited to name, status, architecture, and OS family.

info.name: Disable a specific module stream on a managed instance group

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Disables a module stream on a managed instance group. After the stream is disabled, you can no longer install the profiles contained by the stream.  Before removing the stream, you must remove all installed profiles for the stream by using the [RemoveModuleStreamProfileFromManagedInstanceGroup](#/en/osmh/latest//ManagedInstanceGroup/RemoveModuleStreamProfileFromManagedInstanceGroup) operation.

info.name: Enable a specific module stream on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Enables a module stream on a managed instance group.  After the stream is enabled, you can install a module stream profile. Enabling a stream that is already enabled will succeed.  Enabling a different stream for a module that already has a stream enabled results in an error. Instead, use the [SwitchModuleStreamOnManagedInstanceGroup](#/en/osmh/latest/ManagedInstanceGroup/SwitchModuleStreamOnManagedInstanceGroup) operation.

info.name: Installs package(s) on each managed instance in a managed instance group

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Installs the specified packages on each managed instance in a managed instance group. The package must be compatible with the instances in the group.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Installs a profile for an enabled module stream. If a module stream defines multiple profiles, you can install each one independently.

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

info.name: Perform an operation involving modules, streams, and profiles on a managed instance group

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs:
Enables or disables module streams and installs or removes module stream profiles. Once complete, the state of the modules, streams, and profiles will match the state indicated in the operation. See [ManageModuleStreamsOnManagedInstanceGroupDetails](#/en/osmh/latest/datatypes/ManageModuleStreamsOnManagedInstanceGroupDetails) for more information.
You can preform this operation as a dry run. For a dry run, the service evaluates the operation against the current module, stream, and profile state o

info.name: Changes the enabled stream for a module on a managed instance group

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs:
Enables a new stream for a module that already has a stream enabled.
If any profiles or packages from the original module are installed,
switching to a new stream will remove the existing packages and
install their counterparts in the new stream.

info.name: Reboots managed instances in a managed instance group.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Reboots all managed instances in the specified group.

info.name: Refresh the software information on instances in a managed instance group

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Refreshes the package, Windows update or Snap information on a managed instance with the latest data from the software source. This does not update packages on the instance. It provides the service with the latest package data.

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group.

items.docs: Removes a profile for a module stream that is installed on a managed instance group. Providing the module stream name (without specifying a profile name) removes all profiles that have been installed for the module stream.

items.docs:
Retrieve a list of module streams, along with a summary of their
status, from a managed instance group.  Filters may be applied to select
a subset of module streams based on the filter criteria.

The 'moduleName' attribute filters against the name of a module.
It accepts strings of the format "<module>".  If this attribute
is defined, only streams that belong to the specified module are
included in the result set.  If it is not defined, the request is
not subject to this filter.
